snippet.title: IGS Classic Arcade Collection | Steam Launch Date Trailer
snippet.description:
IGS Classic Arcade Collection brings together 8 classic IGS arcade hits in one collection on PC on August 13th via Steam!

Online multiplayer is supported for up to 4 players.

Wishlist Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417140/IGS_Classic_Arcade_Collection/

■ Collection of works
《Knights of Valour: Super Heroes》
《Knights of Valour Plus》
《Knights of Valour 2 - Nine Dragons》
《Oriental Legend》
《Oriental Legend Spooky》
《Martial Masters》
《Demon Front》
《The Gladiator》
